# doc-exec

Install:

```
composer require --dev rasuvaeff/doc-exec
```

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`
- Immutable by default (`final readonly class`)
- A fenced code block only runs when its info string is exactly `php doc-exec`
  (case-insensitive). A bare ` ```php ` block is illustrative-only and never
  executed unless `MarkdownExtractor(strict: true)`.
- A block is split into top-level statements by `nikic/php-parser`, so every
  construct PHP allows stays one statement: closures, `if`/`else`,
  `try`/`catch`, `match`, anonymous classes, `do`/`while`.
- Markers are trailing `//`/`#`/`/* */` comments on the SAME physical line as
  the statement's last token:
  - *(none)* — the statement must not throw.
  - `// => <expr>` — the statement's value equals `<expr>` (`var_export()`
    comparison, so state not identity). Only valid on an expression statement;
    on `echo`/`if`/`foreach` it is reported as a mistake.
  - `// throws <FQCN>[ | <substring>]` — the statement throws `<FQCN>` (optionally
    with `<substring>` in the message).
  - `// outputs <text>` — the statement's stdout, trimmed, equals `<text>`, trimmed.
  - `// skip` or `// skip: <reason>` — the statement is never executed. The
    grammar is strict: `// skip this in production` is prose and still runs.
- Blocks under the same Markdown heading (ATX or setext) share one variable
  scope, in document order; a new heading starts a fresh scope.
- A block that is not valid PHP fails on its own, with the line number inside
  the block; the other blocks of its scope group still run.
- Every scope group runs in its own child `php` process (never `eval()`, never
  in-process) with `vendor/autoload.php` required automatically, under a
  wall-clock deadline (30 s default).

## API

```php
use Rasuvaeff\DocExec\DocExec;
use Rasuvaeff\DocExec\Report\ConsoleReporter;

// bootstrap: null = search upward for vendor/autoload.php, stopping at the
// first composer.json/.git above the document.
$docExec = new DocExec(bootstrap: null, timeoutSeconds: 30);
$result = $docExec->check('README.md');

$result->passed();     // bool
$result->failedIds();  // list<string>, sha256 stable ids of failing blocks

echo (new ConsoleReporter())->render([$result]);
```

### Result tree

```php
use Rasuvaeff\DocExec\StatementOutcome;

foreach ($result->blocks as $block) {          // list<BlockResult>
    $block->block;        // CodeBlock: file, ordinal, startLine, code, scopeKey
    $block->stableId;     // string, sha256 of file + ordinal + normalised code
    $block->passed;       // bool
    $block->processError; // ?string — set when the block never ran (parse error, timeout, dead process)

    foreach ($block->statements as $statement) {   // list<StatementResult>
        $statement->outcome;   // StatementOutcome::Pass | Fail | Skip
        $statement->message;   // ?string, failure detail
        $statement->statement; // Statement: code, line, trailingComment, kind
        $statement->marker;    // ParsedMarker: type + payload
    }
}
```

- `StatementOutcome`: `Pass`, `Fail`, `Skip`.
- `Statement\StatementKind`: `Expression`, `Import`, `Other`.
- `Marker\MarkerType`: `None`, `Equals`, `Throws`, `Outputs`, `Skip`, `Invalid`.
- `Marker\ParsedMarker` fields: `type`, `expression`, `exceptionClass`,
  `exceptionSubstring`, `expectedOutput`, `skipReason`, `error`.
- `Statement\StatementParseError` (`RuntimeException`): thrown by the splitter
  for a block that is not valid PHP; `blockLine` is relative to the block.

### Extraction and helpers

```php
use Rasuvaeff\DocExec\AutoloadFinder;
use Rasuvaeff\DocExec\MarkdownExtractor;
use Rasuvaeff\DocExec\StableId;

$blocks = (new MarkdownExtractor())->extract($markdownString, 'README.md');
// list<CodeBlock>; indented fences are extracted and dedented

(new AutoloadFinder())->find(__DIR__);                    // ?string
StableId::compute('README.md', 0, '1 + 1; // => 2');      // string
```

### CLI

```
vendor/bin/doc-exec                                           # checks ./README.md
vendor/bin/doc-exec docs/a.md docs/b.md                       # explicit files
vendor/bin/doc-exec --bootstrap=tests/bootstrap.php README.md
vendor/bin/doc-exec --timeout=60 docs/slow.md
vendor/bin/doc-exec --help
```

Exit code `0` when every block passed, `1` when a block failed, `2` on a usage
error (unknown option, missing file). Parsing lives in `Cli\Arguments::parse()`
and raises `Cli\UsageError`.
